title: Lightly Smoked Dutch Baby Lettuce Tagine
description: A sugar-free and nostalgic Dutch dish featuring baby lettuce leaves, lightly smoked with binchotan charcoal, served in a ceramic tagine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic, onion, lemon juice, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper.
Add the baby lettuce leaves to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the lettuce mixture to a ceramic tagine.
Lightly smoke the lettuce with binchotan charcoal for 10 minutes.
Cover the tagine with a lid and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the lightly smoked Dutch baby lettuce tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
